column2: Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, past the village. It is a short walk. I go there only when I must.
Wild leeks grow a short walk east of the village. There are more to the north, a little further on. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water in the east.
Four barrels stand a short walk west of the village. They hold food, and one holds common ingredients. A food barrel stands beside Flaa Heet, who leads the village.
The three dead Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock still carry their weapons and purses.
I keep the stores for this village. I fill the barrels with what the marsh gives, and I know what is in each one.
Flaa Heet leads the village. Three villagers and a child live with him. Two of the villagers sell from stalls.
